title: World Environment Day celebrations kick off in India

sections.heading: Body
sections.text:
Celebrations are underway in Mumbai, India where, on 27 May, thousands of participants took part in the 136th week of the World's Largest Beach Cleanup. Later that day, the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) and UN Environment signed an agreement to "green" the sport of cricket.
Join the World Environment Day celebrations.

## Body
Celebrations are underway in Mumbai, India where, on 27 May, thousands of participants took part in the 136th week of the World's Largest Beach Cleanup. Later that day, the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) and UN Environment signed an agreement to "green" the sport of cricket.
Join the World Environment Day celebrations.
